author: Inside Edition
description: Multi-millionaire real estate mogul George Pino was driving a boat on Labor Day in 2022 when it crashed and sank. Now, he is on trial for manslaughter after 17-year-old Lucy Fernandez was killed and her friend Katy Puig was left with irreversible brain damage in the collision. Pino's attorneys say he never intended to hurt anyone and the crash was an accident. The jury was also shown a haunting video of the moment a team of divers located the wreck of Pino's boat under Biscayne Bay in Florida.
title: Jury Shown Haunting Video At Multi-Millionaire George Pino Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: An Illinois man was pinned under his collapsed roof. His injured wife tried to clear away the debris, and a storm chaser leapt into action to help dig Gary Rymek out. Two police officers quickly joined the effort and removed Gary from the rubble. The rescue took place Thursday after a massive tornado tore through the small town of Streator, Illinois. Inside Edition spoke with Gary and his wife from the hotel where they are now staying.
title: Man Rescued After Being Pinned Under Collapsed Roof

author: Inside Edition
description: A tornado with a massive funnel cloud was caught on camera is it twisted its way across the plains of Lake County, Indiana. A sergeant with the Indiana State Police took the video of the weather phenomenon. It was part of the strong storms that hit Illinois and Indiana this week.
title: Tornado With Massive Funnel Cloud Caught on Camera #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A children's lemonade stand was robbed in broad daylight, and cops are on the hunt for the people who did it. Police in Boston, Massachusetts are asking the public for its help in identifying two suspects shown in surveillance footage. The kids told law enforcement that the unidentified suspects made several passes by the stand, before they approached and asked whether they would accept Apple Pay. Before the young entrepreneurs could respond, the suspects grabbed the stand's money box.
title: Kids' Lemonade Stand Robbed At Gunpoint

author: Inside Edition
description: A police officer accidentally shot a colleague while the two were joking around. It happened in Pasadena, California this past September, and footage of the incident has just been released. Patrol car dashcam shows the vehicle approaching two officers getting ready for their shift. One officer appears to unholster his weapon and point it at the car, in an apparently playful gesture. Moments later, that same officer clutches his arm in pain.
title: Pasadena Cop Accidentally Shoots Fellow Officer
